prompt: Use case: art-direction design for the support structures of a skate park in a stylized open-world game. Image 1 is an in-game screenshot: giant wooden skate ramps and a mega gap high on a volcano's crater rim, floating with nothing under them. Keep its camera, horizon, field of view, terrain and every ramp exactly where and how they are: do not move, reshape or remove any riding surface. Image 2 is the approved art direction: keep its soft painterly style, warm light, dark blue-grey columnar basalt, snow patches, yellow-green moss and autumn shrubs, and paint the ramps as warm wooden ramps with thin steel coping. The supports must look designed, calm and monumental, never like a forest of thin sticks: FEW large solid forms, each clearly readable, rising from the ground to meet the underside of the ramps. Design: tall solid rock fins: each support is one thick blade-shaped wall of dark basalt set along the ramp's direction, as long as 20 to 30 metres, rising from the slope to the ramp's underside, with a sculpted flowing silhouette and one large rounded opening through its middle; few fins, widely spaced, reading like natural lava rock sculpted by wind.
purpose: Crater Park editor park art direction
